display_long_description:
THE CASTLE DOESN'T WANT YOU TO ESCAPE.
Enter a cursed fortress where every gate is a split-second decision. Race forward through dark medieval halls, choose your path and smash through the breakable gate before the wrong choice ends your run.
Gate Smash: Cursed Castle is a fast-paced VR arcade runner built around quick reactions, simple controls and addictive “one more run” gameplay.
CHOOSE FAST
Multiple gates stand in your path. Read the scene, commit to a lane and make your decision before it's too late.
SMASH THROUGH
Hit the correct gate and burst through it with satisfying destruction, impact effects, sound and haptics.
SURVIVE THE CURSE
The farther you travel, the faster and more intense the castle becomes. Stay focused as your reaction time gets shorter.
CHASE YOUR BEST RUN
Build streaks, push your distance and keep coming back to beat your personal best.
ENTER A DARK FANTASY CASTLE
Gothic stone halls, cursed energy, medieval gates and an atmospheric fantasy setting turn every run into a dangerous escape.
Easy to understand. Hard to master.
Choose. Commit. Smash. How far can you survive?
